notablePrerequisites:
You control a Plant.
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
easyPrerequisites: Staff of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Avenger of Zendikar trigger.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
